Read more about why Maia

  • One coworker for the whole team

    Not a private chat window per person. Maia sits in the channel, sees the same thread the team sees, and everyone sees what it did and why.

  • Work with AI in the open

    Ask, correct and approve in the thread, so there are no handoffs. You see how your colleagues use it, borrow what works, and the good habits spread on their own.

  • Company context, built together

    What the channel tells Maia lives in a canvas everyone in the channel can read and edit. It grows with every thread instead of living in one person's head.

  • Never stuck with one model provider

    Maia picks from every major model, including open-weight ones where they fit. Your admin chooses which models a coworker may use, and you can pin one per coworker. Your context stays with you.

One coworker, taught by the whole company.

Maia builds a memory of how your company works: the terms, the rules, the exceptions. Every answer draws on it, and every correction adds to it. Correct it once, and everyone gets the fix from then on.

Questions, answered.

Do I need a card to start?

No. Add Maia to Slack, invite it to one channel, and the first $50 of credits is on us.

When you need more, tell us and we top you up the same day.

What is a credit?

A credit is a unit of Maia's work. Model calls draw credits down as they happen, so a quiet week costs almost nothing and a busy one costs what it used.

Nothing is charged per seat.

What happens when credits run low?

The admin console shows the balance and warns when it runs low.

Ask for a monthly package or a one-time top-up from there, and it lands the same day.

Which models does Maia use?

Any of the major models, including open-weight ones. Maia routes routine work to fast, cheap models and saves the frontier for the work that needs it.

Your admin can pin a model per coworker.

Where does my data go?

Maia runs in its own deployment for your company. What leaves it is calls to the model endpoints, the apps you connect and web search.

In Slack, Maia sees what the thread sees. In your apps, it sees only what you gave it access to.

Can Maia change things outside Slack on its own?

Not anything risky. Reads run straight through. A write goes through a risk gate and your workspace policy, and anything risky waits for someone to approve it.

Every run is logged with who asked, what ran, which tools it used, and who approved.

How does it learn our way of doing things?

Corrections happen in the thread. Maia keeps the note, or adds it to the channel canvas once someone approves, and everyone in that channel gets the fix from then on.

Memory is per channel, so #finance and #support each keep their own.

Can I stop a routine?

Yes. App Home lists the routines you created with their schedule, and you can pause, resume or cancel them there.

Can we run Maia on our own infrastructure?

That is the Enterprise plan. Talk to us and we will walk through it.

Start with one channel.

Add Maia to Slack, invite it to one channel, and ask it something. $50 in free credits, no card up front. If you would rather see it first, we will walk you through it.
